recipes.frontierhunts.sew.lining: Sew Fur Lining into the garment in your hand
recipes.frontierhunts.sew.mittens: Sew Fur Mittens onto the chest piece in your hand
item.frontierhunts.fur_lining.note: Clothing Table: hold any worn piece (camo, ghillie, coveralls, armour) and sew it in: +0.6 warmth.
item.frontierhunts.fur_mittens.note: Clothing Table: hold any chest piece and sew them on: warmer hands, steadier aim in the cold.
item.frontierhunts.tanned_fur.note: Clothing Table: fur hats, mittens, linings, mukluks. Bedrolls at a crafting table.
item.frontierhunts.bear_fur.note: The warmest fur there is: bear fur coats at the Clothing Table.
item.frontierhunts.tanned_heavy_hide.not: Wind- and waterproof. Robes and mukluks at the Clothing Table; bedrolls.
